$comment: EVM-006 W3a: the single source of coverage exclusions, read by the Vitest preset (src/vitest.js), by evia-node-test (src/node-test.js) for tools/*.mjs and by tools/diff-coverage. Every entry needs a reason (docs/process/testing-strategy.md -> Progi).

exclude.reason: EVM-093: native shell of SQLCipher (expo-sqlite); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015); the logic above it is covered in Jest
EVM-130: glue of the Android Keystore for the database key (Expo module); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). Only calls the platform, no decision logic
EVM-130: glue of the Android clipboard (Expo module, sensitive flag); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). Only calls the platform, no decision logic

EVM-130: glue of the JobService (JobScheduler callbacks onStartJob/onStopJob, worker thread, setNotification of a user-initiated job); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). No decision logic: it starts a thread and calls the pure UploadWorker, JobOutcomes and NotificationPlanner (JVM, Kover 95%)

EVM-130: glue of the Expo module (bridge to JavaScript: argument conversion, events, permission request, settings intent); needs the Android runtime and the Expo modules core, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). No decision logic: every function calls the pure engine through UploadRuntime and returns its answer

EVM-130: glue of the Android Keystore (AES-256 key of the token store: generation, lookup, removal); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). The format of the record and every decision on failure are pure (FileTokenVault, JceRecordCipher: JVM tests with a software key)

EVM-130: glue of the notification (channel, PendingIntent, Notification.Builder); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). The texts and the choice of the notice are pure (NotificationText, NotificationPlanner: JVM tests)

EVM-130: glue of JobScheduler (JobInfo.Builder from a JobRequest, SecurityException to a result); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, dumpsys jobscheduler, ADR-0015). The kind, network and persistence of the job come from the pure SchedulePolicy and JobArming (JVM tests)

EVM-110: glue of ConnectivityManager (NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_METERED of the active network, null on no network); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (svc wifi disable, Maestro, ADR-0015). The decision what a video may do on such a network is the pure VideoNetworkPolicy (JVM tests)

EVM-130: wiring of the process (one TokenOwner, files in noBackupFilesDir, meta-data of the manifest, clock readings of the phone); needs the Android runtime, proven on the emulator (Maestro, ADR-0015). Only constructs and connects pure engine classes, makes no decision
